metadata.name: uncertain-save-recovery
metadata.description: Commit one synthetic ordinary UI event in routed Test Genie storage, lose only its browser response, then recover and reopen the same durable event with independent readback.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const original = window.fetch.bind(window); let armed = true; window.__e1D2PostObservation = null; window.__e1D2PostObservationDone = false; window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; const method = (init && init.method || (typeof input !== 'string' && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (armed && method === 'POST' && url.includes('/api/v1/calendar/events')) { armed = false; const response = await original(input, init); if (!response.ok) { const observation = {method:'POST', status:response.status}; if ((response.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase().includes('json')) { try { const value = await response.clone().json(); const known = ['invalid_request','not_found','internal','unauthenticated']; observation.code = typeof value.code === 'string' && known.includes(value.code) ? value.code : 'other'; } catch (_) { observation.code = 'other'; } } else { observation.category = 'other'; try { const reader = response.clone().body.getReader(); const chunks = []; let size = 0; while (size <= 64) { const part = await reader.read(); if (part.done) break; size += part.value.byteLength; if (size > 64) { await reader.cancel(); break; } chunks.push(part.value); } if (size <= 64) { const bytes = new Uint8Array(size); let offset = 0; for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; } if (new TextDecoder().decode(bytes) === 'calendar event operation failed\n') observation.category = 'calendar_operation_failed'; } } catch (_) {} } window.__e1D2PostObservation = observation; window.__e1D2PostObservationDone = true; return response; } throw new Error('synthetic BAS transport: response discarded after server commit (' + response.status + ')'); } return original(input, init); }; return 'one-shot response loss and sanitized rejection observation armed'; })()

metadata.label: Arm one-shot response loss after server commit

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const until = Date.now() + 1500; while (!window.__e1D2PostObservationDone && Date.now() < until) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); if (!window.__e1D2PostObservationDone) return 'no-post-observed'; const observation = window.__e1D2PostObservation; window.__e1D2OwnerRejected = observation.status === 401 && observation.code === 'unauthenticated'; return JSON.stringify(observation); })()

metadata.label: Capture only sanitized event POST rejection status and code/category

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const owner = window.__e1D2OwnerRejected === true; const title = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-title\"]'); const check = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-check-status\"]'); const message = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-message\"]')?.textContent || ''; const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const text = message(); if (owner && text.includes('Sign in or switch to a workspace with calendar access')) { if (!title || title.disabled || check) throw new Error('definitive owner rejection must keep the draft editable and omit uncertain recovery'); return 'definitive-owner-rejection'; } if (!owner && text.includes('save outcome could not be confirmed') && check) return 'uncertain-save-recovery'; await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); } throw new Error(owner ? 'owner rejection message was not rendered' : 'uncertain-save message was not rendered'); })()

(() => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection has no status lookup'; const check = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-check-status\"]'); if (!check) throw new Error('uncertain save did not offer idempotency status lookup'); check.click(); return 'idempotency status lookup started'; })()

(async () => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection has no recovery claim'; const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const text = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-message\"]')?.textContent || ''; if (text.includes('The earlier save succeeded: E1 D2 uncertain synthetic, event')) return 'committed event recovered'; await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); } throw new Error('UI status recovery should resolve the original committed event'); })()

(() => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection; no event identity or durable-state claim'; const text = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-message"]')?.textContent || ''; const m = text.match(/event ([^,]+), revision (\d+)/); if (!m || m[2] !== '1') throw new Error('recovery message did not expose the original revision-1 identity'); window.__e1D2UncertainEventID = m[1]; return JSON.stringify({id:m[1], revision:Number(m[2])}); })()

metadata.label: Retain recovered durable event ID for independent readback

evaluate.expression: (() => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection; reopen not applicable'; const card = document.querySelector('[data-event-title=\"E1 D2 uncertain synthetic\"]'); if (!card) throw new Error('recovered synthetic event was not visible to reopen'); card.click(); return 'reopened recovered event'; })()

(async () => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection; no revision claim'; const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const heading = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"calendar-event-revision\"]')?.textContent || ''; if (heading.includes('EVENT REVISION 1')) return 'reopened at revision 1'; await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); } throw new Error('reopening should show the same event at revision 1'); })()

(async () => { if (window.__e1D2OwnerRejected) return 'owner rejection; no event identity or durable-state claim'; const id = window.__e1D2UncertainEventID; if (!id) throw new Error('recovered event ID was not retained'); const r = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events/' + encodeURIComponent(id)); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('independent durable readback failed: ' + r.status); const e = await r.json(); if (e.id !== id || e.revision !== 1 || e.title !== 'E1 D2 uncertain synthetic') throw new Error('recovery did not resolve exactly the committed durable event'); const q = new URLSearchParams({start_local_date:'2000-01-01', end_local_date:'2199-12-31'}); const listResponse = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events?' + q); if (!listResponse.ok) throw new Error('independent list readback failed'); const list = await listResponse.json(); const matches = (list.events || []).filter(x => x.title === 'E1 D2 uncertain synthetic'); if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one event after recovery; found ' + matches.length); return JSON.stringify({id:e.id, revision:e.revision, title:e.title, durableCount:matches.length}); })()

metadata.label: Independent durable readback confirms exactly one event
